description: Connector-export input contract; not a real captured dataset or product authority.
sources: Object keyed by registry/product/architecture/ui/program/website/prompts/operating/packet. Each has exact allowlisted id, ISO8601 timezone-aware read_at, and full actual plaintext text.
control: Object with complete actual value matrices, including header rows, for Work Graph A1:W201, Decisions A1:J100, Interfaces A1:I100, Overview A1:C100 and Instructions A1:H100. reachable: Object mapping each checked exact baseline to true only after an actual Git read confirms that commit. Do not fabricate reachability.
notes: All input reads must be fresh; keep temporary input private, not in a code repository or packet. Include only redacted output evidence in a packet. Tests use synthetic_test only.
